_comment: The model improvement program (docs/model_program.md): for each model, the score that is frozen each month, the outcome it is scored against, and the targets of each stage.
This file is the one place the targets live. docs/headwind_strategy.md section 1 explains them; scripts/model_scorecard.py reads them here.

scripts/model_vintage.py freezes a model's scores into data/model/vintages/<model>/ and never edits a frozen file. scripts/model_scorecard.py scores every frozen vintage against the outcomes recorded since and opens or closes each stage by the rule below. No step waits on a person.
A new model is one more entry here with a kind the two scripts know. A new place or technology needs no code: the frame and the outcome come from the published record.

scores.rank_note: The score the staff pilot's Headwind band is cut from (scripts/county_record_score.py PROFILE_COLUMN).
scores.chance_note: The held-back model's score, fit to first severe restrictions over a four-year window. It is turned into a chance over the scorecard horizon as 1 - (1 - p) ^ (horizon / window). Only the scorecard measures whether that chance holds.

frame.at_risk: has_severe == 0: no severe restriction on record when the vintage is frozen

outcome.event: the county's first severe restriction (severity 3 or 4, in county_fips_all) enacted after the vintage date and on or before the end of the horizon
outcome.excluded: a county whose severe rule is undated, enacted on or before the vintage date but recorded later, or dated too loosely (a year or a month) to fall wholly on one side of the vintage date or the horizon end

backtest.note: Frozen once, from the first refit that writes the chance column: the held-back model scores the counties with no severe restriction through 2025, and 2026 is its horizon. It is labelled a backtest, it was not frozen on its date, and it never opens a stage.

stages.shown_as: calibrated by region, with the county facts that moved the score

stop_rule.then: the score stays internal and the product sells the record itself (rules, dates, outcomes) without a score
